verdict.rationale: Cursor is itself a coding agent/assistant; the evidence shows it acts as an MCP client (connecting to external MCP servers) rather than exposing itself as an MCP server for other agents to connect to. A probe explicitly confirms mcp.cursor.com does not resolve, meaning Cursor documents MCP client support, not a hosted MCP server — this story's axis (serving as an MCP server) is a category mismatch for an agent-role product like Cursor.
